  • July 26th - Monte is formed with a roster consisting of REDSTAR, rallen, joel, Woro2k, and BOROS. [1]
  • August 3rd - Monte part ways with rallen and sign DemQQ and KrizzeN, with the latter joining as coach and manager. [2][3]
  • September 15th - Monte sign Fessor. [4]
  • October 11th - BOROS benches himself. [5]
  • October 19th - Monte bench joel. [6]
  • November 11th - Monte sign kRaSnaL. [7]
  • November 21st - BOROS rejoins the active roster. [8]
  • November 22nd - Monte bench REDSTAR. [9]
  • January 12th - Monte bench Fessor. [10]
  • January 13th - joel is acquired by GODSENT. [11]
  • January 18th - Monte sign sdy and lmbt, with the latter joining as coach. KrizzeN becomes the team's assistant coach. [12][13]
  • February 20th - Monte part ways with Fessor. [14]
  • March 15th - Monte part ways with REDSTAR. [15]
  • June 20th - BOROS is acquired by Team Falcons. [16]
  • July 12th - Monte acquire br0 from Astralis Talent. [17]
  • February 26th - Monte part ways with sdy following the expiration of his contract. [18]
  • March 1st - br0 is acquired by Astralis. [19]
  • March 18th - Monte promote Gizmy and ryu from Monte Gen. [20]
  • May 10th - Monte demote ryu to Monte Gen. [21]
  • May 13th - Monte demote Gizmy to Monte Gen. [22]
  • May 14th - Monte sign STYKO and add hAdji as a stand-in. [23][24]
  • July 5th - Monte bench Woro2k. [25]
  • July 8th - Monte part ways with hAdji. [26]
  • July 10th - Monte acquire dycha and hades from ENCE, and sign nawrot as an assistant coach. [27]
  • August 13th - Monte bench STYKO and sign KEi. [28]
  • September 2nd - Monte part ways with lmbt. [29]
  • September 3rd - Monte promote nawrot to a head coach position. [30]
  • September 20th - Monte release STYKO. [31]
  • December 20th - Monte bench KEi and part ways with nawrot. [32][33]
  • January 1st - Monte part ways with kRaSnaL. [34][35]
  • January 6th - Monte promote ryu, Gizmy, and AiyvaN from Monte Gen, the latter as coach. [36]
  • February 16th - dycha steps down from the active lineup. [37]
  • February 17th - Monte promote leen from Monte Gen. [38]
  • March 22nd - Monte release dycha. [39]
  • April 4th - Woro2k is acquired by Passion UA. [40]
  • April 7th - Monte bench hades while DemQQ is acquired by Passion UA. [41][42]
  • April 8th - Monte sign hAdji and afro. [43]
  • April 15th - Monte loan hades to G2 Esports. [44]
  • April 30th - KrizzeN is acquired by FURIA. [45]
  • June 2nd - Monte part ways with leen and hAdji. [46]
  • June 18th - hades' loan to G2 Esports expires and he returns to the bench. [47]
  • July 1st - Monte release hades. [48]
  • July 4th - KEi is acquired by Inner Circle Esports. [49]
  • July 25th - Monte sign AZUWU and Bymas. [50]
  • August 2nd - Monte part ways with AiyvaN and sign kakafu as his replacement. [51][52]
  • January 8th - ryu is acquired by Astralis. [53]
  • February 10th - Monte sign Rainwaker to complete their roster. [54]
  • July 1st - Monte part ways with afro, AZUWU, and Bymas following the expiration of their contracts while Rainwaker and Gizmy are acquired by Luminosity Gaming and 100 Thieves, respectively. [55][56]
  • August 25th - kakafu is acquired by Luminosity Gaming. [57]
